_note: UI-04 motion table: one entry per 'moment'. Read by UI3Motion (scenes/shared/ui3/UI3Motion.gd). Times in ms. trans/ease are Godot names without the TRANS_/EASE_ prefix. Seeded with the timings that were hardcoded in code before UI-04, so adding this file changed nothing visible. See design/handoffs/ui-04-polish/token-audit.md. UI-04 round 1 (handoff motion.md): one entry per row below the two seeded moments. Engine fields (UI3Motion.play): in/hold/out, shake, particles + particles2, hitstop_ms, sweep, hide/free_on_done. Other fields are data for the screen that plays the moment: trigger, delay_chain / delay_per_index_ms, sfx_name (design name; NOT in gacha_timing.json yet, so nothing plays), skip (rule text), reduce_flash (what the reduce_flash setting changes), star (a moment: any click/Space skips to the end state via opts.skip). Reduce motion (MetaState.reduce_motion) strips shake, hitstop, particles and slides inside play().

turn_banner._note: CombatView._show_turn_banner: PLAYER TURN / ENEMY TURN plate. 390 in, 750 hold, 360 out.

combo_banner._note: CombatView combo chip: pops in, lives COMBO_FLOAT_SEC (1.8 s) in total (caller passes hold_ms 1550), fades 250.

die_select._note: die lift -18, side shadow 6->12, cream outline in; other dice modulate 0.85 (caller sets the others)

die_used._note: die scale 1->0.92, alpha 0.4, 'used' tag fades in (caller)

hit.trigger: damage below a big hit and not a crit
hit._note: Layers 'enemy_flash', 'knockback' (3D enemy) and 'hp_fill' / 'hp_trail' (enemy plate) are table data the 3D stage / plate own; 'number', 'shake', 'sparks' are wired. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (hit). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.
hit.skip: not skippable (240 ms of control lock max)

crit._note: 'enemy_flash' / 'knockback' (3D) and 'hp' (plate) are data; 'tag', 'number', 'sweep', 'shake', sparks and the 40 ms hit-stop are wired. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (crit). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.
crit.skip: click / Space ends the float early

big_hit.trigger: damage >= 25% of the target's max HP, or a knockout (client-side)
big_hit._note: Number is text_hero 56 scaled 0.52 -> 1.95 -> 1.5 (= the old 72 x 1.3, no 72 size, Liam 28/10). 'launched' (3D) and 'plate_pop' (enemy plate) are data; the rest is wired. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (big_hit). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.

axie_ko._note: 'last_flash' / 'tips_over' (3D Axie: CombatStage3D.play_death) and 'hp' / 'card_dims' (DieCard, dice lane) are data; 'vignette', 'label', 'stamp', 'shake' are wired. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (axie_ko). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.

shield_gain.trigger: a shield face resolves (shield goes up)
shield_gain._note: 'segment' (shield segment on the HP bar) is data; 'bubble', 'number', 'glints' are wired. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (shield_gain). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.

turn_banner_player._note: Full-width band (size.banner_h, colour banner_player) at y 200: slides x -1920 -> 0 (240 EXPO OUT), holds 500, -> +1920 (240 QUAD IN). Played by U5TurnBanner. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (turn_banner_player). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.
turn_banner_player.skip: click / Space ends it; a click is only held for the first 240 ms, Space (and the End turn key) never reaches the fight while the band shows (Liam 29/10)

turn_banner_enemy._note: Full-width band (size.banner_h, colour banner_enemy) at y 200: slides x -1920 -> 0 (240 EXPO OUT), holds 500, -> +1920 (240 QUAD IN). Played by U5TurnBanner. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (turn_banner_enemy). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.
turn_banner_enemy.skip: click / Space ends it; input is only held for the first 240 ms

boss_intro_band.trigger: a boss fight starts (its first Your turn), shown before the Your turn band
boss_intro_band._note: BossIntroBand over the arena (boss-intro--default, design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/ui05-combat-panels.html): band unfolds scaleY 0 -> 1 (210 BACK OUT, the Phase 2 band beat), holds 1600 (frame label), out 210 QUAD IN; the SkipHint fades with it. Facts are the boss HUD numbers (HP, SHELL, ENRAGE). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5BossBand.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline (UI-05 b1 integration, Liam 29/10).
boss_intro_band.skip: click, Space or the End turn key ends the band; that press never reaches the fight

intent_reveal.trigger: after the Your turn banner, one intent block per enemy
intent_reveal._note: 'pills' is played with UI3Motion.play on each IntentBlock (in = the same numbers), +80 ms per enemy. 'border_flash' and 'strip' run on big-hit plates. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (intent_reveal). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.

attrition_card._note: slides down 16 + fade after the banner; each new turn one pip fills with a number pop (caller)

boss_phase.trigger: the boss crosses a phase tick (Phase 2)
boss_phase._note: 'segment' / 'tick' (boss bar, enemy lane) and 'roar' (3D boss) are data; hit-stop, flash, band, shake, shards are wired. Band = U5PhaseBand over the boss mid-body, 1 s. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (boss_phase). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.

waiting_server._note: all actions modulate 1->0.4, the pill fades in, dots pulse 0.3<->1 (900 loop); only after 300 ms of waiting

victory._note: U5VictoryBand: scrim, rays, band (text_hero 56 held at scale 1.3, no 72 size), sub-line, continue hint, shake, confetti. First click / Space jumps to the end state, the second continues. Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (victory). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.
victory.skip: click / Space jumps to the end state; a second press continues

defeat.trigger: the last Axie is down (Party down panel)
defeat._note: 'panel' is also the top-level in (DefeatPanel plays it 200 ms after the trigger, so in.delay_ms 500 lands it at 700). 'tint' is U5Moments.defeat; 'darken' is the DefeatPanel scrim; 'sinks' is the 3D party (data). Source: design/handoffs/ui-05-figma/round-1/motion-batch1.md (defeat). Played by scenes/combat/ui5/U5Moments.gd with UI3Motion.play_timeline.
defeat.skip: click / Space jumps to the panel (buttons still wait 1000 ms)

core_reveal_moss._note: 3 cards drop from y-40 + fade, 80 ms x card, tier band last; 6 fragments per card

core_reveal_amber.trigger: Core offer with at least one Amber
core_reveal_amber._note: as Moss + the Amber card wobbles (+-3 deg, 2 steps) + sweep on its band at +240

core_reveal_crystal.trigger: Core offer with at least one Crystal
core_reveal_crystal._note: as Amber + 2 sweeps, card hop (y-24 and back), shake +-4

gacha_flip._note: scale x 1->0->1 with the new face + tier band colour (caller); particles per tier = the core_reveal_* rows

core_take._note: chosen card shrinks into its slot in the Cores plate, others fade 120; trail in the tier colour (caller sets color)

anchor_awaken._note: scrim 160, card 0.6->1.1->1, 8 rays 12 deg/s, title letters pop one by one, Anchor chip turns lemon at the end. AnchorFx stays the implementation
anchor_awaken.reduce_flash: no flash, no sweep, rays static

level_up._note: Axie card hop 160, level number pop, light sweep on the card

reward_take._note: card lifts -18 (200) then flies to its HUD target (280)

treasure_open._note: lid shakes 3 steps (300), opens (owner anim, 600), relic card rises 40 + fade (240) at +700, sweep

echo_idle._note: chest bob y +-6, 2400 ms loop (caller loops in+out); 3 slow motes

echo_open._note: squash 1.1/0.9 x2, shake +-6, burst, chest swaps to the rarity tier chest, card rises at +700 (300); particles cur_stone or cur_fragment

echo_dupe._note: DUPLICATE chip stamps in 1.4->1, one Fragment sprite per Fragment flies to the meter at +200, meter counts up 400

echo_rare._note: before the card: band in rarity colour, 2-step sweep, rays (Legendary+), hold +600; Mythic adds shake +-10; 30-60 fragments tinted rarity (caller sets color_token per rarity)
echo_rare.reduce_flash: no flash, no sweep, rays static

echo_open10._note: 10 cards flip one by one (120 each, 80 ms x index); best one last with its Rare+ treatment

pass_level_up._note: XP bar fills (count-up 600), level badge pop + sweep, the level card on the track gets the cream outline

daily_claim._note: reward chip pops, 8 sprites of the reward icon fly to the HUD chip

land_tier_up._note: band in 240, camera push-in 4% over 600, Stone particles, sweep +400, hold 1400, band out 240

currency_gain._note: count-up on the chip + fly-to-chip (8 sprites of that currency, 40 ms stagger); chip pops when the first sprite lands

run_end_win._note: panel scale 0.96->1, Shard hero count-up 800 at +240, fly-to-chip, shard fountain

net_notice._note: RETRY spinner replaces the label while retrying

update_bar._note: bar slides down 56, the screen's top margin animates 0->56 (caller)
